Sherdog's live UFC
334 “Gane vs. Hokit” coverage will begin Saturday at 5 p.m.
ET.
 Evan
Elder (156) vs. Samuel
Sanches (153.6)
 Round 1
Lightweights kick off UFC 334 festivities inside Madison Square
Garden, as Elder (10-2, 3-2 UFC) squares off with Sanches (11-1,
0-0 UFC) at 155 pounds. Kevin MacDonald administers the law and
order. They forego the glove touch. Elder walks through heavy fire,
staggers the Brazilian with a left hook and pursues an early
finish. He executes a takedown, lands in half guard and goes to
work on the ground. This might prove fortuitous for Sanches, who
gets a chance to shake off the cobwebs. Elder maneuvers behind him.
Sanches gets to his knees, grabs the fence and gets to his feet.
Elder stays glued to him along the cage. He lands an elbow on the
break, then turns to low kicks. Sanches counters with a straight
right. Body kick from Elder. Halfway home in what has been a busy
first round. One-two from Elder, who backs it up with a head kick.
Sanches pins him to the fence with punches, then resets in open
space. Sharp jab from the Brazilian followed by a right hand over
the top. Thudding one-two from Sanches, who once again pins him to
the fence with punches. Elder answers with a leg kick. They trade
jabs. Overhand right from Elder, who turns back to the leg kicks.
Sanches lands on the counter. Elder connects with a straight right
and drops the off-balance Brazilian in the closing seconds.
 Sherdog Scores
Brian Knapp scores the round: 10-9 Elder
Scottie Smith scores the round: 10-9 Elder
Dayne Fox scores the round: 10-9 Elder
 Round 2
Back at it for the middle stanza. They trade jabs out of the gate.
Elder targets the upper lead leg with kicks. Sanches shakes off a
takedown attempt and delivers a knee up the middle, then resets.
More jabs from the Brazilian. They exchange body blows. Sanches
sits down the American with a straight right, allows him to stand
and pours on additional punishment. Elder answers with a cracking
right and shoots on the hips but goes nowhere. Sanches forces him
to clinch. Elder lands a knee to the body and breaks. He sneaks in
a right hand over the top, then scores with hooks from both hands.
Two minutes left in the round. Sharp one-two from Sanches. Elder
responds in kind, then goes to the body. Sanches reacts noticeably.
Elder weathers an apparent eye poke, targets the head and body with
jabs, shoots and secures a double-leg takedown. Smart tactical
approach from the underdog.
 Sherdog Scores
Brian Knapp scores the round: 10-9 Elder
Scottie Smith scores the round: 10-9 Elder
Dayne Fox scores the round: 10-9 Elder
 Round 3
Sanches could be in a two-round hole here and might need a finish
to salvage his Octagon debut. Elder approaches behind punches and
eats an elbow that draws blood. He changes levels and completes
another takedown. Sanches gets back to his feet, only to get
dragged down to the mat. Elder controls the farside wrist and
flirts with a hammerlock, allowing his opponent to stand. Sanches
breaks free and lands to right hands. Elder crashes forward, resets
and paws with his lead hand. Another standing elbow lands for
Sanches. Elder circles on the outside, whiffs on a one-two and
scores with his jab. Midway through the round. Elder sneaks in a
right uppercut and a right hand over the top. Sanches backs him up
with return fire. Elder shoots and drives through a double-leg into
a takedown, landing in side control. Ninety seconds on the clock.
Elder wheels behind the kneeling Brazilian, makes a pass at a
rear-naked choke and scores with punches. Sanches grabs the fence
and loses a point. Elder chases an arm-triangle, loses position and
stands. He lands a low kick and a right hook to the body. Sanches
answers with an elbow over the top. Elder secures a body lock and
nets another takedown. He drops elbows, punches and hammerfists to
salt away a likely decision.
 Sherdog Scores
Brian Knapp scores the round: 10-8 Elder (30-26 Elder)
Scottie Smith scores the round: 10-8 Elder (30-26 Elder)
Dayne Fox scores the round: 10-8 Elder (30-26 Elder)
 The Official Result
Evan Elder def. Samuel Sanches—Unanimous Decision (30-26, 30-26,
30-26) 
 Juan
Diaz (136.4: Missed Weight) vs. 
 Heili
Alateng (135.6)
 Round 1
Next on the UFC 334 docket: a bantamweight tilt pitting an
overweight Diaz (16-1-1, 1-0 UFC) against Alateng (18-10-2, 6-3-1
UFC) at 135 pounds. Keith Peterson draws the officiating
assignment. A customary glove touch and show of respect gets them
started. Diaz opens with a left hook, then a leg kick. One-two from
Alateng. Diaz looks to counter, then turns to his jab. Sharp
one-two from the Peruvian. Diaz sneaks in two left hooks, then
lures his opponent in the clinch. They separate. Alateng scores
with an inside leg kick. More jabs from Diaz, who then shoots a
right hand to the body. Diaz lands a one-two and evades the return
fire. They clinch again, and Diaz scores with a knee to the body
before pressing his counterpart into the cage. They exchange shots
and separate. Alateng sneaks in a right hand over the top. Diaz
answers with a body kick and punches to the head. Alateng clinches,
and they trade knees to the body. They separate and float to the
center. Diaz continues to pester the Mongolian with his lead hand.
One-two from the Peruvian to close the round.
 Sherdog Scores
Brian Knapp scores the round: 10-9 Diaz
Scottie Smith scores the round: 10-9 Diaz
Dayne Fox scores the round: 10-9 Diaz
 Round 2
After the first five minutes, Alateng finds himself faced with an
uphill climb. Diaz greets him with a jab. They trade low kicks.
Diaz cuts loose with a one-two, follows with a jab and lands
another one-two. He now zeroes in on the body. Alateng answers with
a left hook upstairs. More jabs from Diaz. They clinch in the
center. Diaz controls the position and pushes the Peruvian to the
fence. They trade knees, then separate. More lead-hand punishment
from Diaz. Midway through the round. Heavy body kick from Diaz. He
doubles up on right uppercuts and follows with a left hook. Slick
stuff from Diaz. Alateng flicks out his jab. Diaz answers in kind.
He lands hooks from both sides, resets and connects with a one-two.
Damage piling up on Alateng’s face. Diaz crashes into the clinch,
lands a close-range knee and elbow and resets. Alateng a step or
two behind on the feet. More jabs from Diaz.
 Sherdog Scores
Brian Knapp scores the round: 10-9 Diaz
Scottie Smith scores the round: 10-9 Diaz
Dayne Fox scores the round: 10-9 Diaz
 Round 3
Alateng almost certainly needs a finish as they wade into the final
five minutes. Diaz opens with jabs and shoots a straight right to
the body. Alateng gives ground, feints and eats more shots to the
head. Diaz starting to turn up the heat. They trade left hooks.
Diaz doubles up on his jab. Alateng answers with an overhand right.
Diaz counters a level change with a low kick, then lands a series
of blistering power punches to the head. He triples up on his jab
and forces Alateng to retreat. Midway through the round. Alateng
snatches a single-leg in the center of the cage. Diaz defends
without issue, then hammers away with punches. Has to be
disconcerting for Alateng. Diaz fires a front kick, connects with a
jab and misses with a follow-up right. He sticks and moves with a
little more than a minute left on the click. They trade in the
center of the cage. More jabs from Diaz, who has controlled
virtually every minute of this fight. He strings together a volley
of punches. Alateng answers and appears to stagger the Peruvian
with a right uppercut, but the finish he needs does not
materialize.
 Sherdog Scores
Brian Knapp scores the round: 10-9 Diaz (30-27 Diaz)
Scottie Smith scores the round: 10-9 Diaz (30-27 Diaz)
Dayne Fox scores the round: 10-9 Diaz (30-27 Diaz)
 The Official Result
Juan Diaz def. Heili Alateng—Unanimous Decision (30-27, 30-27,
30-27) 
 Macy
Chiasson (134.8) vs. Beatriz
Mesquita (135.8)
 Round 1
Women’s bantamweights are next to the stage at UFC 334, where
Chiasson (10-6, 8-6 UFC) awaits the undefeated Mesquita (8-0, 3-0
UFC) at 135 pounds. Blake Grice adjudicates matters. They circle at
the start, Chiasson with a noticeably height and reach advantage.
She paws with her jab. Mesquita stalks and jabs, slowly closing the
distance. She sneaks behind Chiasson, elevates her and nearly
secures a takedown. Mesquita eventually gets the takedown and
unleashes her ground-and-pound from half guard. Midway through the
round. Mesquite climbs to full mount, floats to the back and
flattens out her opponent. 
She drops a vicious 12-to-6 elbow, smashes away with punches,
cinches the rear-naked choke and laces a body triangle for good
measure. Chiasson has no choice but to tap .
 The Official Result
Beatriz Mesquita def. Macy Chiasson—Submission (Rear-Naked Choke)
3:23 R1 
 Jared
Gordon (155.6) vs. Melquizael
Costa (155.4)
 Round 1
The spotlight at UFC 334 returns to the lightweight division, as
Gordon (21-9, 9-8 UFC) toes the line against Costa (26-8, 7-3 UFC)
at 155 pounds. Charged with policing the proceedings, Marc Goddard
beckons them forward. Gordon presses forward behind a body kick.
Front kick to the body from Costa. He flicks out a jab, stays
patient and hunts counters. Two more front kicks to the body from
Costa. Gordon blocks a high kick. He crashes into the clinch, then
separates. More kicks from Costa, who targets the American at all
levels. Gordon reaching on his punches. He eats another body kick.
Costa circles and continues to fire off kicks. He whiffs on a wheel
kick, then turns his attention back to the midsection. Ninety
seconds left. Costa stings his counterpart with a head kick and
left hook. Gordon’s left arm taking a beating blocking kicks. He
clinches but gains no ground.
 Sherdog Scores
Brian Knapp scores the round: 10-9 Costa
Scottie Smith scores the round: 10-9 Costa
Dayne Fox scores the round: 10-9 Costa
 Round 2
Costa picks up where he left off with the kicks, some to the body,
some to the head and some to the legs. Gordon ducks into a takedown
and gets to work in full guard. Costa cinches a triangle from the
bottom. He transitions to an armbar, then goes back to the
triangle. Gordon escapes and moves behind the Brazilian. He flirts
with a rear-naked choke but stays attached. Costa stands and frees
himself. Two minutes on the clock. They trade left hooks along the
fence. Gordon makes a pass at another takedown but winds up on the
bottom. He scrambles, reshoots and secures the takedown. Costa
neutralizes him from the bottom. Gordon mixes in some short punches
and passes to half guard. He ends the round with some
standing-to-ground punches.
 Sherdog Scores
Brian Knapp scores the round: 10-9 Gordon
Scottie Smith scores the round: 10-9 Gordon
Dayne Fox scores the round: 10-9 Gordon
 Round 3
Could be a round apiece here. Gordon ducks a high kick and slings
the Brazilian to the mat. Costa escapes to his feet. Gordon
clinches and completes a trip takedown. He climbs to full mount
briefly, then settles in half guard. Costa gets to his knees at the
base of the fence, then stands. He lands a body kick and an
uppercut. Gordon shoots and pins the Brazilian to the fence. They
separate. Body kick from Costa, who follows with a one-two and an
inside low kick. Two minutes on the clock. Costa lands an uppercut
at close range, then targets the body with a left hook. Another
uppercut from Costa, who pieces together a multi-strike combo. They
trade. Both men land. Costa denies a takedown attempt, lands a
front kick and narrowly misses a spinning elbow. Gordon gets in on
the hips and drags the action to the mat in the waning seconds.
Costa counters with a kneebar as the bell sounds.
 Sherdog Scores
Brian Knapp scores the round: 10-9 Costa (29-28 Costa)
Scottie Smith scores the round: 10-9 Costa (29-28 Costa)
Dayne Fox scores the round: 10-9 Costa (29-28 Costa)
 The Official Result
Melquizael Costa def. Jared Gordon—Unanimous Decision (29-28,
29-28, 29-28) 
 Donte
Johnson (189) vs. Cesar
Almeida (189.6)
 Round 1
They keep the UFC 334 line moving with a catchweight affair between
the unbeaten Johnson (9-0, 3-0 UFC) and Almeida (7-3, 3-3 UFC) at
190 pounds. MacDonald steps in as the third man in the cage and
gives the green light. Johnson plows forward behind a jab and two
leg kicks, looking to crowd his opponent early. Almeida steps into
a right hand. Johnson gets off a Superman punch, follows it with
straight shots and resets. One-two from Johnson. Almeida lands an
overhand left and backs it up with a left hook to the body. Johnson
circles. Almeida connects with hooks from both hands. He whiffs on
an elbow, scores with a jab to the head and then zeroes in on the
body. Body kick from Johsnon. Almeida floors the American with a
right hand, swarms him with follow-up shots and flirts with a
guillotine. Johnson gets to his feet and eats more shots.
He returns fire and pays for it. Almeida drops his opponent with a
right hook, lands another behind it and prompts the
stoppage .
 The Official Result
Cesar Almeida def. Donte Johnson—TKO (Punches) 3:20 R1 
 Jim
Miller (155.6) vs. Terrance
McKinney (160.2: Missed Weight)
 Round 1
Attention at UFC 334 now shifts to a lightweight confrontation
slotting the venerable Miller (39-19, 28-18 UFC) opposite the
overweight McKinney (18-9, 8-6 UFC) at 155 pounds. Peterson
oversees the action. Away they go. McKinney greets the veteran with
jabs, lands a one-two and rattles the New Jersey native’s cage with
an uppercut. Miller answers with a pair of right hooks and an
inside leg kick. One-two from Miller. McKinney doubles up on his
jab. Miller lands with a counter left over the top.
Front kick to the body from McKinney, who zaps his opponent with a
straight left. Miller stumbles and collapses, then eats a barrage
of follow-up shots that forces Peterson’s hand .
 The Official Result
Terrance McKinney def. Jim Miller—TKO (Punches) 1:53 R1 
 Drew
Dober (155.4) vs. Chris
Duncan (155.4)
 Round 1
Next up at UFC 334: a lightweight battle matching Dober (29-15,
15-11 UFC) with Duncan (15-3, 6-2 UFC) at 155 pounds. Grice takes
the reins as referee. Dober paws with his lead hand. Duncan greets
him with an inside leg kick. They exchange body kicks. Dober scores
with a straight left, then gets back to his jab. Duncan responds
with a body kick. The Scot lands a head kick, then buckles Dober
with a right hook. Body kick from Duncan, then another. He follows
it with a chopping right hand over the top. Significant damage to
Dober’s right eye already. Duncan clinches and drives his
counterpart to the fence. They separate. Ninety seconds to go in
the round. Dober counters a body kick with a straight left. He
swarms with punches and lands a knee to the body. Inside leg kick
from Dober to close the round.
 Sherdog Scores
Brian Knapp scores the round: 10-9 Duncan
Scottie Smith scores the round: 10-9 Duncan
Dayne Fox scores the round: 10-9 Duncan
 Round 2
Duncan greets the American with a series of kicks to various
levels. He steps into a clean right hand over the top, resets and
fires off a combination. Duncan connects with another straight
right, then follows it with a sweeping low kick. Dober answer with
a leg kick and a few jabs. Duncan continues to unleash kicks to the
legs, body and head. They trade right hands. Two minutes left in
the round. They circle and paw at one another. Dober hunts for a
home for a straight left, as the action slows. Duncan lands an
elbow and a body kick. Dober responds with a volley of upper cuts
from the collar tie. Duncan steps into a knee to the body near the
end of the round.
 Sherdog Scores
Brian Knapp scores the round: 10-9 Duncan
Scottie Smith scores the round: 10-9 Duncan
Dayne Fox scores the round: 10-9 Duncan
 Round 3
They hug to start Round 3. Duncan opens with a one-two and another
body kick. Dober gets off hooks from both hands. Inside leg kick
from Dober, who shoots a straight left to the body. Duncan changes
levels and shoots on the hips. Dober denies the takedown. Body kick
from Duncan. More pressure from Dober, perhaps sensing he is behind
on the card. He blocks a high kick, presses forward behind one-twos
and keeps Duncan on the back foot. Duncan steps forward with hooks
from both hands, then lands a glancing Superman punch. Two minutes
on the clock. Duncan not throwing much anymore. They trade right
hands in the center of the cage. Body kick from Duncan. Dober
lunging on his punches with a little more than a minute left. He
doubles up on the left hand, eats a body kick and sneaks in a right
hand. Duncan ducks a punch and secures a takedown. He sets up in
half guard and milks valuable time off the clock. Elbows drop next,
several at a time, to close it out.
 Sherdog Scores
Brian Knapp scores the round: 10-9 Dober (29-28 Duncan)
Scottie Smith scores the round: 10-9 Dober (29-28 Duncan)
Dayne Fox scores the round: 10-9 Dober (29-28 Duncan)
 The Official Result
Chris Duncan def. Drew Dober—Unanimous Decision (30-27, 30-27,
29-28)
